$description: Real `vendors` table rows captured live 2026-07-21 from the local vision DB (5,545,335 rows) via psql. Solicitation/job/match rows are synthetic (no triaged solicitation with an IT NAICS code exists yet in this environment — the only real row, id=17, is a cancelled vehicle-purchase notice with no set-aside) but are shaped exactly per 01-schema.sql / 02-api-contract.json.

resolved_unknowns.contact_email_sentinel: CONFIRMED real value: vendors.contact_email can literally be the string 'The business owner has hidden this information from public searches' (137,698 rows). The candidate-pool query and the vendor_matches join must convert this exact string to NULL before it reaches the API response or the outreach UI.
resolved_unknowns.capabilities_null_rate: CONFIRMED: 49% of vendors.capabilities is NULL (2,713,172 of 5,545,335). The capability_only tier of the candidate pool only ever surfaces the other 51%.
resolved_unknowns.naics_codes_all_shape: CONFIRMED: comma-space-separated TEXT (not an array/JSONB), e.g. '518210, 519290, 541219, ...'. Candidate-pool SQL must use LIKE '%541511%' style matching (existing /api/vendors pattern), not array containment operators.
resolved_unknowns.existing_solicitation_row: The only live solicitations row (id=17) has naics_code='3361' (partial/truncated — vehicle purchase, not IT) and set_aside_type=NULL. It is NOT usable as a positive vendor-matching example; used only for the 'no eligible candidate pool' edge case below.
